_source: Saves (Oct 9, PROPOSAL from the decisions doc: local save worlds in v1.0, cloud saves in v1.x, 'multiple save slots (worlds)'). Up to 5 worlds on a device; each save keeps its last 2 versions as backups; the game autosaves after every week.
_historyNote: History kept in a save (agreed Oct 10): transfer records of the last 5 seasons. Retired players keep name, clubs and season-by-season numbers; players who never played are dropped. The inbox keeps its newest 100 messages (inbox.json).
